cases.prompt: Apply /ResearchPlus to a research question with source requirements.
assertions: Resolve to research-unbounded without losing evidence traceability.
Use checkpointed volumes only when required by actual limits.
cases.grader: Review observed output and repository artifacts against every assertion; record PASS, FAIL, BLOCKED, or NOT TESTED with supporting evidence. Never infer PASS from the existence of this fixture.

assertions: Both aliases preserve identical source and length policies.
